name: westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_connect_mode_clicked
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConfigDialog::OnConnectStringModeClicked toggles the dialog-level WOL password/connect-string save flag.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Reconstructed remains limited because Binary Ninja renders the test/sete toggle as a byte-field assignment artifact; assembly is unambiguous for source behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4420e0 validates a leaf thiscall void handler that reads m_wolPasswordFlag at offset 0xe8, clears eax, tests the old value, sets al when the old value is zero, and stores eax back to m_wolPasswordFlag.
Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_config_dialog_connect_mode_clicked_smoke verifies 0 toggles to 1, 1 toggles to 0, and an arbitrary nonzero value also becomes 0.
